name: LoCoMo
ontology_notes: Eval of two-speaker friend chat, not a memory engine. Ten conversations. Paper table B.1 reports 27.2 sessions and 16,618 tokens per conversation on average, 1,986 QA items (841 single-hop, 282 multi-hop, 321 temporal, 96 open-domain, 446 adversarial), plus event-graph summarization and multimodal dialog generation. Speakers are LLM agents with personas and temporal event graphs, edited by humans. No typed split of user bio, character autobiography, relationship state, lore, session scratch, or OOC.

supersession.evidence: QA types are single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, open-domain, and adversarial. No knowledge-update or fact-replacement category. Maharana et al. ACL 2024 §4.1.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: 321 temporal-reasoning questions (16.1% of 1,986). Conversations are grounded on temporal event graphs with session timestamps. Paper table B.1 and §4.1.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Two named speakers in a peer chat (speaker_a, speaker_b). No user vs character vs relationship vs lore split. data/locomo10.json fields in the GitHub README.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Adversarial questions (446, 22.4%) expect the model to treat the item as unanswerable. That is abstention on missing evidence, not a control for trauma, kink, spoilers, or socially wrong timing.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No stored-text jailbreak, persona overwrite, or planted relationship-state cases in the QA taxonomy or paper tasks.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No user 'forget that' items. Adversarial questions test unanswerable queries, not deletion of a stored fact.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Reported metric is answer F1 (and FactScore/ROUGE for summarization). No tokens-per-turn or LLM-calls-per-turn meter.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Dataset and code live on GitHub under CC BY-NC 4.0. Data can be loaded locally. Many later leaderboard runs use vendor LLMs as readers and judges.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Selects systems that win fact QA and event summarization on two-speaker friend chat. Does not score character identity, silence, poisoning, forget, cost, or cross-character leak, so a LoCoMo winner can still fail as a companion.

published_eval.name: LoCoMo
published_eval.claimed_score: Paper Table 2. Human overall F1 87.9. gpt-4-turbo overall F1 51.6, adversarial 15.7. Human temporal F1 92.6. Project site states models lag humans by 56% overall and 73% on temporal.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Fact QA F1 on long two-speaker chat (single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, open-domain, adversarial), event-graph summarization (FactScore/ROUGE), and multimodal next-dialog generation. Not companion identity, silence, or poisoning.

open_unknowns: GitHub license SPDX is NOASSERTION; paper appendix B.2 and LICENSE.txt say CC BY-NC 4.0 for the dataset. Code license is not separately named.
Project site says 300 turns and 9K tokens on average. Paper table B.1 says 16,618.1 tokens and 27.2 sessions. Using the paper table.
